meta.actionKo: 기생충의 에너지 대사를 차단하여 회충·요충 등 장내 기생충 감염을 치료하는 구충제입니다.
meta.actionEn: An anthelmintic that treats intestinal parasitic infections such as roundworms and pinworms by blocking the parasites' energy metabolism.

a71c45d3.pointEn: An albendazole anthelmintic for treating intestinal worm infections and mixed infections.

en.a71c45d3: This medicine is used to treat infections with roundworms, pinworms, hookworms, whipworms, American hookworms, and threadworms (Strongyloides), and mixed infections of these.
en.0d9412a7: For roundworms, hookworms, whipworms, and American hookworms, take 1 tablet (400 mg) as a single dose.
en.ef2642ce: If infected with roundworms, hookworms, whipworms, or American hookworms, take 1 tablet (400 mg) as a single (1-time) dose.
en.c8832998: For roundworms, hookworms, whipworms, and American hookworms, take 400 mg as a single dose.
en.36f33fb1: Adults and children 24 months and older take 1 tablet (400 mg), 1 time a day, for pinworms. For eradication, take 1 more tablet (400 mg) once, 7 days later.
en.6c3196bf: Adults and children 24 months and older, if infected with pinworms, take 1 tablet (400 mg), 1 time a day. For eradication, take 1 more tablet (400 mg) once, 7 days later.
en.90cd6ff3: Adults and children 24 months and older, if infected with pinworms, take 1 tablet (400 mg), 1 time a day. For eradication, take 1 more tablet (400 mg) once, 7 days later. If infected with roundworms, hookworms, whipworms, or American hookworms, take 1 tablet (400 mg) as a single (1-time) dose. For severe mixed infection of threadworms (Strongyloides) with other parasites (tapeworms), take 1 tablet (400 mg), 1 time a day, for 3 days. If the tablet is hard to swallow, it can be chewed or taken with a small amount of water; no special measures such as stopping meals or using laxatives are needed. Get tested 3 weeks after treatment, and if the infection has not been cured, a 2nd course may be given depending on the case.
